Nadia, Gideon's final number for Vantorre Group in his July 1 update in #strategic-pod was **280 seats**.

He first posted 300, then corrected himself a few minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The production roster had 280 active seats as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280 in the thread.
